headline: Brazilian Steel Producers Drop in New York Trading
summary: Gerdau fell 3.01% and CSN dropped 7.55% in New York trading, while the SLX steel fund dipped 0.12%.
why: Gerdau and CSN are major Latin American steelmakers whose internationally traded shares reflect global industrial and construction sentiment.

impacts.name: CSN
impacts.why: Negative sector momentum weighed heavily on steel equities in foreign trading.

why_moved: Negative sentiment surrounding regional steel demand prompted selling in ADR shares of major producers.
